identity.name: Royal Oak Offshore Chronograph 42

case.bezel: octagonal with eight hexagonal screws, ceramic pushers and crown

identity.one_liner: The 2014 generation of the 42mm Offshore chronograph — in-house base caliber, ceramic crown and pushers.

narrative.story: The 26470ST updated the 42mm Offshore chronograph in 2014, swapping the old 2226-based movement for the manufacture 3126 with a Dubois-Depraz chronograph module, and dressing the case with ceramic screw-down crown and pushers. Its dial family — safari, navy, grey 'elephant' — defined the Offshore's look through the late 2010s until the 26238 generation with the integrated 4401 chronograph replaced it.
narrative.collector_notes: Ceramic pusher chips and aftermarket straps are the inspection points; AP's quick-change strap system arrived only with the successor, so strap condition matters here. Safari dials lead the variant hierarchy.
